cases.name: policy-v1-root-path
cases.refusal: agent writer policy: root deny path is not supported

cases.name: policy-v1-empty-paths
cases.refusal: agent writer policy: denyWritePaths must not be empty

cases.name: policy-v1-unclean-path
cases.refusal: agent writer policy: path "//a" must be clean and absolute

cases.name: policy-v1-capabilities
cases.refusal: agent writer policy: requiredCapabilities must be exactly ["filesystem/deny-write/v1"]

cases.name: policy-v2-invalid-ipv4
cases.refusal: agent writer policy: decode policy: network address must be a canonical IPv4 literal

cases.name: policy-orphan-subdirectory
cases.refusal: policy path policies/extra is orphaned, unreferenced, or not a regular policy file

cases.name: eval-orphan-file
cases.refusal: eval path evals/writer/cases/extra.json is orphaned, unreferenced, or not a regular evaluation file

cases.name: eval-agent-mismatch
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation index agent does not match owning agent

cases.name: eval-input-vt
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation case requires input and 1..1000 assertions

cases.name: eval-input-next-line
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation case requires input and 1..1000 assertions

cases.name: eval-input-nbsp
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation case requires input and 1..1000 assertions

cases.name: eval-rubric-byte-limit
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation rubric must be nonblank, at most 4096 bytes, and free of controls except newline and tab

cases.name: eval-pattern-byte-limit
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation regex must be nonblank and at most 1024 bytes

cases.name: eval-regex-lookahead
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation regex must use valid RE2 syntax

cases.name: eval-minpasses-without-runs
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation minPasses requires runs

cases.name: eval-minpasses-exceeds-runs
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation minPasses must be positive and no greater than runs

cases.name: eval-duplicate-assertion-ids
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation assertion id is invalid or duplicated

cases.name: eval-case-filename
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation case filename must match its id

cases.name: eval-raw-minscore-fraction
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation JSON: json: cannot unmarshal number 50.0 into Go struct field EvaluationAssertion.assertions.minScore of type int

cases.name: eval-raw-runs-exponent
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation JSON: json: cannot unmarshal number 1e0 into Go struct field EvaluationCase.runs of type int

cases.name: agent-id-newline
cases.refusal: agent writer: id is invalid

cases.name: eval-id-newline
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation case id is invalid or duplicated

cases.name: eval-judge-newline
cases.refusal: agent writer evaluations: evaluation judge identity must be nonblank printable ASCII of at most 256 bytes
